analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 43.4 exiting oversold but still in neutral territory. MACD histogram improving but remains negative. 5-day low of $51.71 is higher than 20-day low of $50.25, forming a Higher Low pattern. Volume is subdued at 0.39x the 5-day average. Overall QQQ down 1.4% intraday. Lacking clear direction, maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
